name: Getlink SE
summary: Getlink SE, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, finance, construction, and operation of fixed link infrastructure and transport system in France and the United Kingdom. It operates through Eurotunnel, Europorte, and ElecLink segments. The Eurotunnel segment operates tunnels of a length of approximately 50 kilometres each under the English Channel, as well as terminals at Folkestone in the United Kingdom and the Coquelles in France. It also provides passenger shuttle services for the transport of trucks, cars, motor homes, caravans, coaches, motorcycles, trailers, commercial vans, and other vehicles.
